Main.sentence: The One America Appeal is a ___E:501(c)(3) U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/501(c)(3)_organization)___ nonprofit organization founded on 7 September 2017, by all five then-living former ___E:U.S. Presidents U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/U.S._President)___ : ___E:Jimmy Carter U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Carter)___ , ___E:George H. W. Bush U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_H._W._Bush)___ , ___E:Bill Clinton U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bill_Clinton)___ , ___E:George W. Bush U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_W._Bush)___ , and ___E:Barack Obama U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama)___ .

This joint appeal originally aimed to encourage support for recovery efforts for ___E:Hurricane Harvey U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hurricane_Harvey)___ , but was then extended to include areas most affected by Hurricanes ___E:Irma U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hurricane_Irma)___ and ___E:Maria U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hurricane_Maria)___ .

The appeal was launched when the five former Presidents aired a joint ___E:PSA U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_service_announcement)___ on the ___E:NFL's U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Football_League)___ regular season opening broadcast.

All funds collected through this fund will go into a special account established through the ___E:George H. W. Bush Presidential Library Foundation U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Bush_Presidential_Library)___ and then all proceeds will be distributed to assist hurricane victims.
According to an update issued on 21 October 2017, the effort has raised $31 million in funds from more than 80,000 donors.
The appeal concluded fundraising on 31 December 2017 and raised $41.3 million in total from around 110,500 donors.

A benefit concert, "Deep from the Heart: The One America Appeal", was held on 21 October 2017 at the ___E:Reed Arena U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reed_Arena)___ at ___E:Texas A&M University U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas_A%26M_University)___ in ___E:College Station U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/College_Station,_Texas)___ and headlined by all five living former U.S.

Presidents ( ___E:Barack Obama U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama)___ , ___E:George W. Bush U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_W._Bush)___ , ___E:Bill Clinton U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bill_Clinton)___ , ___E:George H. W. Bush U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_H._W._Bush)___ , and ___E:Jimmy Carter U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Carter)___ ).
Ticket sales and other proceeds went to the special hurricane recovery effort.

The concert was hosted by ___E:Lee Greenwood U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lee_Greenwood)___ , with Martin Guigui as Music Director, and featured the country music band ___E:Alabama U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alabama_(American_band))___ , ___E:Sam Moore U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Moore)___ , ___E:Yolanda Adams U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yolanda_Adams)___ , ___E:Lyle Lovett U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyle_Lovett)___ and ___E:Robert Earl Keen U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Earl_Keen)___ .  ___E:Lady Gaga U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Gaga)___ made a surprise appearance, performing " ___E:Million Reasons U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Million_Reasons)___ ", " ___E:You and I U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/You_and_I_(Lady_Gaga_song))___ " and " ___E:The Edge of Glory U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Edge_of_Glory)___ " at the concert.

The Texas A&M University Singing Cadets also made an appearance to sing " ___E:The Star-Spangled Banner U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Star-Spangled_Banner)___ ", "God Bless the USA" (alongside Greenwood), and " ___E:Lean on Me U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lean_on_Me_(song))___ " at the end of the concert.
A pre-taped video message from sitting US President ___E:Donald Trump U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump)___ was shown during the concert, in which he described the effort as "tremendous".
